solutions.title: String check
solutions.strategy: Convert the number to decimal text and compare characters from both ends.

timeComplexity.explanation: The d decimal digits are read at most once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The decimal string stores all digits.

solutions.title: Reverse half the digits
solutions.strategy: Reverse the lower half of the digits and compare it with the remaining upper half.

timeComplexity.explanation: Only about half of the d digits are moved into the reversed half.
